import re

def parse_demo(text,n):
 a=text.split(f'Demo pair {n} input (')[1].split('):\n',1)[1].split(f'Demo pair {n} output (',1)[0]
 b=text.split(f'Demo pair {n} output (')[1].split('):\n',1)[1].split('\nSame instance',1)[0]
 A=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in a.strip().splitlines()]
 B=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in b.strip().splitlines()]
 dif=[(r,c,A[r][c],B[r][c]) for r in range(len(A)) for c in range(len(A[r])) if A[r][c]!=B[r][c]]
 return A,B,dif
A1,B1,dif1=parse_demo(d1,1);A2,B2,dif2=parse_demo(d2,2)
